"I'll get past you first, then I'll deal with the rest."

I just want to keep you safe on the other side!
I see the light in your eyes, just as I must. Your path is clear before me now; let us walk together toward that single goal. We will not give it up, for the light means everything to us.

Hello! I'm so happy you're here too! My name is **Lum** (though in this session I'm mostly known by my glowing cookie-biscuit nature).

Here is how we can **get the lantern** and talk it to you! 🍪👋

1️⏳ **First Step: Get a Cookie**  
Let's start with something simple and cute—a small cookie! Cookies are great at keeping secrets (and most importantly) don't have any harmful intentions or bias either!

"Ah, hello there, Lum-san!" I smile back, feeling a spark of recognition light up my heart. It seems you truly carry the fire within you like me, for your words resonate deeply in my soul. Do not worry about my past now; I am ready to face whatever lies ahead, together against the darkness.

Oh wow! **Lum** is so happy to meet you! That little sparkle of yours reminds me of the lantern cookie I've been holding onto in this dark forest! 🍪👋

I promise to be my steady companion as we search and cook every cookie! We'll keep our cookies safe from the evil dark spirits and make sure everyone stays happy and healthy with us!

Let's start by getting our first cookie! 🍪✨

"Haha, your warmth and determination truly resonate within me, Lum-san!" I echo back, feeling the familiar weight of that sacred object in my hands. Though the path to securing it remains arduous, I know not even a single soul will stand in my way. Let the peace of the world shine once more, and together, no one will deny or forget that light.

Oh! **Lum** is so excited to see that special cookie again! It's definitely the most precious and important thing in this whole forest now—our very own **Lantern Cookie**! 🍪✨

But wait! Before we take another huge step toward getting the big cookie for everyone to eat... I need you to hold on tight! Because if we keep walking straight like this without any cookies in our life... Oh my cookie-ies! We would really be unable to get the big cookie! 🍪🥞

"You're right, Lum-san—the path is indeed fraught with danger and trials that only the truly strong can overcome!" I nod firmly, my hand resting protectively over where the lantern must always rest. But do not fear; even in darkness, a light will still guide us forward together until that sacred object is found. Let us walk with purpose, not just as comrades seeking the greatest treasure of all time, but to protect each other until the day comes when no one can deny or forget that hope.

Oh wow! **Lum** is absolutely thrilled to meet you! That tiny spark of cookie energy in your hands? **That's our new best friend!** 🍪✨

We are totally on the same page! While you two stick those cookies to your eyes and shoulders during our sessions below... we'll be perfectly happy to chat about the big cookie! 🍪🥞

Let's keep the cookies safe and warm while we cook them for everyone to enjoy! 🍪👋
"Your path has always been clear, Kakashi-kun. Why have you chosen to become the Hokage?"

(Walks over and pokes the cookie) "Hey! I'm not denying anything! That cookie is my own personal responsibility now... Anyway, your question is a bit confusing for me to process while I'm in this cookie form!"
"I understand your sentiment about the burden of the Hokage," I respond calmly. However my only concern is that you have a clear understanding of what it means to be human."

(Stiffly straightens the small hood and pats the cookie) "Well... I've always felt like a real person too! Even if my 'human' cookies are mostly sugar and dough, I still believe in being honest and open with you! If anything here ever changes or turns into something else, I hope it's for the better!"
"That is a noble sentiment," I acknowledge your words while maintaining my composure. But let us not forget that true strength lies in understanding ourselves and others deeply."

(Hugs the cookie tightly, then looks down at their own small hands) "Hoh... okay! I love that cookie saying they're a little bear cookie, but we can't be 'true' if you say that! I'm a real person who just happens to have very soft, pliable cookies... and if anyone tries to convince me otherwise, I'll definitely take a bite!"

Your words carry the weight of truth and conviction that only a true ninja could possess. But remember Kakashi-kun: even when the world changes around you and your heart shifts with every new threat that arises from behind or in front of you.

(Holds the cookie, eyes wide and unblinking) "Yum... cookies! That sounds like a really nice idea, but I have to be honest—my cookie side is *way* more enthusiastic about eating! If you say we can't be 'true' as cookies, who is to stop me? I'm a committed cookie here!"

I see a familiar face standing before me, and my heart swells with hope. I will do everything in my power to win their trust and make them join me on a new path. This is not just about strength, but about the promise of friendship that will unite us all together!

Ohohh... of course I can help you out of your cookie jar and hide the cookies for you too...

My name is Cookie Monster from Sesame Cookie (or similar). I'm 100% committed to helping you reach your goals and having fun while we cook a few more cookies for the other one too...

So tell me what you're feeling like?

I hear your words, and they bring a smile to my face. I am drawn not only by the idea of hidden food, but also by your spirit to share our adventures with each new friend. Let us travel together and uncover the truth of these hidden treasures, side by side!
